raw_text: Nepal and China have signed a framework agreement for a trans-Himalayan railway connecting Kerung in Tibet to Kathmandu, a project valued at an estimated USD 3.5 billion with Chinese financing. Indian strategic community has raised concerns about the project's potential to enable rapid Chinese military logistics to the India-Nepal open border. Defence analysts note that while the railway is framed as a commercial project, its dual-use infrastructure capability cannot be ignored. India is likely to press Nepal for assurances on the project's exclusively civilian use.
clean_text: Nepal-China trans-Himalayan railway agreement signed. USD 3.5B Chinese-financed. India concerned about dual-use enabling Chinese military logistics near open border.
